name: JSON
author: Dave Gamble and cJSON contributors
description: Validate, pretty-print, minify and query JSON files from the Terminal. Type cjson file.json (pretty-print/validate), cjson -c file.json (compact), cjson -q .foo.bar file.json (pick a value by dotted path), or cjson -l file.jsonl to process one JSON value per line.

descriptions.en: Validate, pretty-print, minify and query JSON files from the Terminal. Type cjson file.json (pretty-print/validate), cjson -c file.json (compact), cjson -q .foo.bar file.json (pick a value by dotted path), or cjson -l file.jsonl to process one JSON value per line.
descriptions.it: Valida, formatta, comprime e interroga file JSON dal Terminale. Scrivi cjson file.json (formatta/valida), cjson -c file.json (compatto), cjson -q .foo.bar file.json (estrai un valore per percorso), oppure cjson -l file.jsonl per un valore JSON per riga.
